integrity: The proof is analytic. It reconstructs the radial inverse Fourier kernel with the source normalization, separates the bulk Bessel regime from the transition tail, and evaluates the logarithmic coefficient from the periodic mean of |cos|^{4/3}. The numerical decimal is not used as evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the canonical trapezoidal planar mollifier and the convolution-kernel L^{4/3} norm. It does not determine the exact endpoint Fourier multiplier norm, does not treat arbitrary mollifiers, and does not assert a higher-dimensional analogue.
title: Exact leading constant for the endpoint kernel norm of a trapezoidal disc mollifier
